confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors use Seoul cost-of-living averages updated in October 2026. Cocktail and wine values are bounded estimates based on their local price relationship to beer. Lodging is a holistic estimate and varies substantially by season and neighborhood.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food and drink are based on Seoul-specific prices, while lodging is estimated for Seoul as a major East Asian capital.
